achiev_hint_first_plugin: Open PackIt, go to the installation interface and pick any plugin from the repository. Tap the install button and confirm the installation.
achiev_hint_plugins_5: Browse through the available repositories and install 5 plugins in total. Try exploring different categories to find something useful.
achiev_hint_plugins_10: You are getting the hang of it. Install 10 plugins across any repositories. A good moment to add a few extra repos to expand your options.
achiev_hint_plugins_25: At this point you clearly enjoy customizing your client. Keep installing plugins until you reach 25 total installations.
achiev_hint_plugins_50: 50 installations means you know what you want. At this point you probably have a solid setup. Keep going.
achiev_hint_plugins_100: 100 plugins installed. You have tried almost everything out there. Do you even remember what half of them do?
achiev_hint_plugins_250: 250 installations. At this point PackIt is basically your lifestyle. Keep installing, there is no going back.
achiev_hint_plugins_500: 500 plugin installations. We are not sure if this is impressive or concerning. Either way, you have earned this.
achiev_hint_repo_1: Add your first repository. Open PackIt settings, go to Repositories and paste a valid repository URL.
achiev_hint_repo_3: Add 3 repositories in total. More sources mean more plugins to discover.
achiev_hint_repo_5: You are pulling plugins from 5 different repositories. At this point you know exactly where to look.
achiev_hint_repo_10: 10 repositories added. You have probably seen every plugin available at this point.
achiev_hint_repo_50: 50 repositories. There is no way all of these are active. Are you okay?
achiev_hint_share_1: Share a plugin file with someone. Open any plugin in the installation interface, tap the burger menu and hit Share.
achiev_hint_share_5: You have shared 5 plugins. Your friends are either grateful or confused by now.
achiev_hint_share_10: 10 shares done. You are basically running your own plugin delivery service at this point.
achiev_hint_share_25: 25 plugins shared. People probably come to you when they need a recommendation.
achiev_hint_share_50: 50 shares. You are holding this community together one plugin file at a time.
achiev_hint_share_100: 100 plugins shared. At this point sharing is just a reflex for you.
achiev_hint_download_1: Download a plugin file to your device. Open any plugin in the installation interface, tap the burger menu and hit Download.
achiev_hint_download_5: You have downloaded 5 plugin files. Your downloads folder is getting interesting.
achiev_hint_download_10: 10 plugin files downloaded. Clearly you like having things locally, just in case.
achiev_hint_download_25: 25 downloads. You are building quite the offline collection.
achiev_hint_download_50: 50 plugin files saved locally. Nothing gets past you without being downloaded first.
achiev_hint_code_1: Open the source code of any plugin. Tap the burger menu in the installation interface and hit Code.
achiev_hint_code_3: You have looked at the code of 3 plugins. Good habit — always know what you are installing.
achiev_hint_code_5: 5 plugins inspected. You are getting comfortable reading other people's code.
achiev_hint_code_10: 10 code reviews done. At this point you probably have opinions about code style.
achiev_hint_code_25: 25 plugins reviewed. You take security seriously and that is genuinely admirable.
achiev_hint_code_50: 50 code views. You probably spot patterns across plugins by now.
achiev_hint_code_100: 100 plugins checked before installing. Trust no one. Read everything. Stay safe.
achiev_hint_code_200: 200 code reviews. At this point you have read more plugin code than most plugin authors.
achiev_hint_report_1: Report a plugin for the first time. If something looks wrong, tap the burger menu in the installation interface and hit Report.
achiev_hint_report_5: 5 reports submitted. You are actively helping keep the ecosystem clean.
achiev_hint_report_10: 10 reports. You clearly care about the quality of what gets distributed here.
achiev_hint_report_25: 25 reports filed. The community is safer because of people like you.
achiev_hint_report_50: 50 reports. Nobody gets away with a bad plugin on your watch.
achiev_hint_report_100: 100 reports submitted. Either you have very high standards or very low tolerance. Probably both.
achiev_hint_copy_1: Copy a plugin link for the first time. Open any plugin in the installation interface, tap the burger menu and hit Copy link.
achiev_hint_copy_5: 5 links copied. You like sending people directly to specific plugins.
achiev_hint_copy_10: 10 links copied. You are a reliable source of plugin references.
achiev_hint_copy_50: 50 links copied. Your clipboard history must be fascinating.
achiev_hint_copy_100: 100 plugin links copied. At this point copy-pasting is basically muscle memory.
achiev_hint_copy_250: 250 links copied. You are a living directory of plugin links at this point.
achiev_hint_level_1: Welcome. You are just getting started.
achiev_hint_level_5: You have spent enough time with PackIt to know your way around. Level 5 reached.
achiev_hint_level_10: PackIt is no longer new to you. It is just part of how you use Telegram now.
achiev_hint_level_25: Level 25. At this point it is safe to say you are not going anywhere.
achiev_hint_level_75: Level 75. Most people never get this far. You are not most people.
achiev_hint_level_80: Level 80. You have invested too much to stop now. Not that you would want to.
achiev_hint_level_90: Level 90. The end is in sight. You can almost see the top from here.
achiev_hint_level_95: Level 95. Five levels away from the absolute maximum. Finish what you started.
achiev_hint_level_100: Level 100. The maximum. There is nothing beyond this point. You have seen it all.
achiev_hint_days_30: You have been using PackIt for a month. The plugins are already part of your daily setup.
achiev_hint_days_182: Six months with PackIt. You have seen updates come and go and you are still here.
achiev_hint_days_365: A full year. PackIt has been part of your Telegram experience through all of it.
achiev_hint_days_730: Two years in. Assuming PackIt and exteraGram are still around — and if you are reading this, they are.
achiev_hint_days_1095: Three years. Honestly impressive. We hope the plugin ecosystem is still alive and well by now.
achiev_hint_days_1460: Four years. At this point you have probably outlasted a few Telegram forks. We appreciate your loyalty.
achiev_hint_days_1825: Five years. Half a decade. We genuinely did not expect anyone to reach this. Is exteraGram even still a thing?
achiev_hint_days_2190: Six years. If you are still using PackIt in 2030 or whenever this is, you deserve a medal. Or a doctor.
achiev_hint_days_2555: Seven years. PackIt is either immortal or you forgot to uninstall it. Either way — respect.
achiev_hint_days_2920: Eight years. At this point we are genuinely surprised this codebase still runs. So are you, probably.
achiev_hint_days_3285: Nine years. Is Telegram still relevant? Is exteraGram maintained? We have no idea. But here you are.
achiev_hint_days_3650: Ten years. A decade. This achievement was written as a joke. We did not think anyone would ever see it. Hi.
achiev_hint_secret_premium: I feel sorry for you if you were in a public place, or near your parents. But at least now you have premium.
achiev_hint_secret_terraria: Now you're a terrorist... Should I call the police? Or the FBI?
achiev_hint_secret_identity: Bro, I don't think you're seriously the creator of the PackIt. Real or fake?
achiev_hint_secret_curiosity: Why did you click here? There's nothing here. Go install some plugins. Seriously, close this and do something useful.
achiev_hint_secret_subscriber: You joined the PackIt channel. Now you are officially part of the loop. Updates, changelogs, chaos — all yours.
achiev_hint_copy_25: 25 plugin links copied. People probably come to you when they need a direct link to something.
achiev_hint_download_100: 100 plugin files saved. Your storage is basically a plugin museum at this point.
achiev_hint_repo_20: 20 repositories connected. You have built yourself a serious plugin network.
achiev_hint_share_200: 200 plugins shared. At this point you are basically a one-person distribution network.
achiev_hint_plugins_75: 75 plugins installed. You clearly know what you are doing at this point.
achiev_hint_plugins_200: 200 installations. You have explored more of this ecosystem than most people ever will.
achiev_hint_report_200: 200 reports filed. Nobody takes quality more seriously than you. Nobody.
achiev_hint_code_75: 75 plugins reviewed. You read more code than most developers write.
achiev_hint_code_150: 150 code reviews. Trust is earned, not given. You made sure of that.
achiev_hint_level_60: Level 60. The maximum. There is nothing beyond this point. You have seen it all.
